desc: How much of the Boki bond meter (0..1) a hunter's own ultimate (X) pays when it lands. Nothing is paid on the cast alone. HeroUlt.bond pays it through KinBond.add once the main session ships that hook, else Bond.add.

tender.note: a support ult cannot land on a foe: a completed tether pays complete, one that stood a downed teammate up pays rescue; the tethered teammate's own meter gets ally

rimewright.note: per foe the crash stuns, up to cap; an early cancel stuns nobody and pays nothing
